ala-kol-trek-guide:
## Walk it with us
Want a local guide, packhorses and a hot-spring finish? The pass is part of our [Song-Kol to Ala-Kol ride and trek (7 days)](tour.html?slug=song-kol-to-ala-kol-horse-riding-trekking-7-days) and of the [Best of Kyrgyzstan (10 days)](tour.html?slug=best-of-kyrgyzstan-10-days). If the climb sounds like too much, [Active Kyrgyzstan (6 days)](tour.html?slug=active-kyrgyzstan-6-days) treks the gentler Altyn-Arashan valley instead.
best-time-to-visit-kyrgyzstan:
## Match the season to a trip
Coming in summer? Ride to [Song-Kol on horseback (3 days)](tour.html?slug=song-kol-lake-on-horseback-3-days) while the jailoo is green. From November to April we run our only [winter ride to a frozen Song-Kol (3 days)](tour.html?slug=winter-horse-back-riding-to-song-kol-lake-3-days). For the shoulder months, the [Ysyk-Kol road trip (4 days)](tour.html?slug=ysyk-kol-lake-road-trip-4-days) runs from April right into November.
yurt-culture-etiquette:
## Sleep in one, not just read about it
Every Song-Kol trip stays with real herder families. Start small with [Song-Kol on horseback (2 days)](tour.html?slug=song-kol-lake-on-horseback-2-days), or live the daily rhythm on the [authentic horseback tour (5 days)](tour.html?slug=authentic-horseback-riding-tour-5-days) with yurt and shepherd-house nights.
real-local-guides:
## Meet them on the trail
Our guides shine brightest on the long rides: a full week in the saddle on the [horseback riding tour (7 days)](tour.html?slug=kyrgyzstan-horseback-riding-tour-7-days), or far off the map on the [untouched mountains ride (6 days)](tour.html?slug=untouched-mountain-horse-riding-tour-6-days).
tailor-made-trips:
## Start shaping yours
Use the [trip builder](builder.html) to sketch your dates and interests, or take a base like the [Best of Kyrgyzstan (12 days)](tour.html?slug=best-of-kyrgyzstan-12-days) and bend it to fit. Short on time? [Kyrgyzstan in a week (7 days)](tour.html?slug=kyrgyzstan-in-a-week-7-days) packs the icons into seven days.
safety-in-the-mountains:
## Comfortable first steps
If you want the mountains with a soft landing, the [family tour (4 days)](tour.html?slug=kyrgyzstan-family-tour-4-days) and the gentle [Discover Kyrgyzstan road trip (7 days)](tour.html?slug=discover-kyrgyzstan-7-days) keep the wild scenery and skip the hard passes.
community-tourism:
## Trips built around local homes
The [authentic road trip (8 days)](tour.html?slug=authentic-road-trip-tour-8-days) sleeps in family guesthouses and nomad camps most tours never reach, and the [untouched mountains ride (6 days)](tour.html?slug=untouched-mountain-horse-riding-tour-6-days) stays with herders the whole way.
easy-from-abroad:
## Land, ride, done
Both of these start and end in Bishkek and pack the country into one simple loop: [Kyrgyzstan in a week (7 days)](tour.html?slug=kyrgyzstan-in-a-week-7-days) and the faster [express tour (5 days)](tour.html?slug=kyrgyzstan-express-tour-5-days).
fair-honest-pricing:
## See it in practice
Every tour page lists exactly what's included, day by day: compare the [ultimate road trip (9 days)](tour.html?slug=kyrgyzstan-ultimate-road-trip-9-days) with the compact [Active Kyrgyzstan (5 days)](tour.html?slug=active-kyrgyzstan-5-days) and you'll see the same open pricing on both.
